sections.shortTitle: Punjab Provincial Assembly Salaries Allowances and Privileges of Members Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT X OF 1994
ACT X OF 1994
PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT). ACT, 1994
1. Short title and commencement: ‑‑(1) This Act may be
called the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of
Members) (Amendment) Act 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on an from the eighteenth day of
October, 1993.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Provincial Assembly Salaries Allowances and Privileges of Members Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Amendment of section 26-A of Ordinance VI of 1979

ACT X OF 1994
ACT X OF 1994
PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT). ACT, 1994
2. Insertion of section 7‑A
in Act XVI of 1974: ‑In the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974 after section 7, the following
shall be added:
"7‑A. Accommodation
Allowance.‑‑Where Official accommodation is not provided to a
Member he shall be paid an accommodation allowance at the rate of seven hundred
rupees per day for the period of residence on duty.
